section.title: Accessing
section.p: The server should be installed by your organization and you should receive the URL that you need to use in order to access . That URL represents the platform main page.

section.title: Sign Up
section.p: If this is your first time before using , you must create an account by signing up to . Go to the platform main page and look for the Sign Up option, that will display a sign up form. Follow the steps to complete the sign up process.

p.note: If is configured to provide Google or GitHub authrntication, it only uses your social account to read your name and email address. No other data is accessed.

requires a valid email address to complete your account sign-up process. Even if you choose to log in using a social account, the email address associated with that account might not be public (this is the default case for GitHub). In this case, asks you to provide one.

section.title: Log In
section.p: Go to the platform main page and look for the Log in option, that will display a log in form. Follow the steps to complete the log in process.

section.title: Accessing
section.p: The Cloud service is available at:
This page represents the platform main page. From here, users can create new organizations, or sign-up / log in into the organizations they belong to.
Once you know your organization, you can access the organization workspace in two ways:

li.p: From the platform main page, by selecting the organization.
Directly by accessing the organization-specific URL.

section.p: The organization URL has the following form:
Where orgid is the unique identifier of that organization.
Users can belong to multiple organizations. However, authentication is handled separately for each organization, so you will need to sign up or log in to each organization you want to access.

section.title: Create a new organization
section.p: To create a new organization, go to the Cloud main page:
and use the Create new organization action, then follow the steps in the setup wizard to complete the process.
During this process you will be asked to:

ul.li: Provide the Organization ID. This identifier will be used to generate the organization URL.
Sign up within the organization. You will be assigned the Organization Administrator role for the new organization.

section.p: After the organization is created, its workspace will be available at:
Where orgid is the identifier you selected during the organization creation process.

section.title: Sign-up to an organization
section.p: If you want to join an organization, chances are that you receive an invitation to join that organization. In that case just follow the invitation link that will get you to sign-up into that organization.
In case you do not have an invitation, then you need to know the organization ID. You can start on the Cloud main page:
and use the I know my organization ID action and follow the steps to complete the sign-up process.
During this process you will be asked to:

ul.li: Provide the Organization ID. This identifier will be used to generate the organization URL.
Sign up within the organization. If you were invited already then a user role will be assigned to you, otherwise you will get the chance to ask the admin to allocate you a user role.

section.title: Log in to an organization
section.p: To log in into your organization workspace you can start on the Cloud main page:
and select your organization, if it appears in the list of recent organizations, or use the I know my organization ID action and follow the steps to complete the log-in process.

section.title: Forgot Your Password
section.p: To reset your password, use the Forgot your password link in the Log in form. You are directed to a page where you can enter your email address and you will receive an email with instructions to reset your password.The Forgot your password link is displayed only if an email server is configured.

section.title: Profile Management
section.p: To view your profile information, click your user name in the top-right corner of the interface. This opens a drop-down menu that offers the following options:

dlentry.dd: This opens a profile settings page that displays your name, email, avatar, and allows you to delete your account or specify which types of notifications will be sent to you via email.

Opens the My Review Tasks page in the main area that displays a list of all the current tasks that you created, those that were assigned to you, and those that have been finalized (if the finalized tasks category is not shown, click the Show finalized review tasks link).
Select this option to log out of your account.
